title: Doji Follow-Through
summary: Of the sessions that closed as a session-level doji — close within 10% of the session range from the open — how often the NEXT session closed green. The denominator is doji sessions with a next session on record; the numerator is the ones followed by a green close. A doji is an indecision flag, so the informative comparison is against the unconditional next-session green rate: a doji that changes nothing is itself a finding.
deltas: a stated, reproducible doji definition instead of an eyeballed one
next-session return distribution attached alongside the rate
compose with gap state or weekday to test the pattern in context
